paraphrase: (Quoting the Varāha:) The wearing of (Viṣṇu's) emblems is of two kinds, heated and with clay; heated emblems are to be worn at set times of the year and at the thread ceremony, in the presence of the great teacher.
speaker: Nārāyaṇācārya (quoting the Varāha)
notes: Summary only — the procedure is deliberately not recorded (restricted practice). checked against the Devanāgarī e-text in sources_raw/raw_etexts/vedAntam/dvaitam (github.com/sanskrit/raw_etexts); numbering follows that copy and may differ in other editions
